digest.component_or_area: MCP adapter and write tool signatures
propositions: MCP transition_ticket and claim_ticket handwritten signatures omit parameters (force, reason, caused_by, ref) already supported by the library and CLI.
FastMCP derives JSON schema from the handwritten callable signatures and discards undeclared payload keys before the adapter runs.
The adapter bodies independently forward only close_class and assignee, so signature changes alone would not reach the core without forwarding updates.
The signed 2026-08-18 operator ruling establishes total lib/CLI/MCP parity for force with absent certification as the audit signal, rescinding the prior force-only policy.
Reason-required closes, explicit culprit attribution, explicit completion refs, and authorized plan-gate bypass are currently unreachable over MCP.
